name: Nestle India Ltd.
business_summary: Indian arm (62.8% Nestle SA, model knowledge) of the global food group: Maggi noodles and sauces, Nescafe, KitKat/Munch chocolates, milk products (Nestle a+ dahi, Milkmaid), infant nutrition (Cerelac, Lactogen), pet care. Q2 FY27: sales Rs 6,788 cr (+20% y/y), operating margin 24%, PAT Rs 1,010 cr (+36%) with advertising spend +46%. Stock nonetheless fell ~9% on 15 Oct on management's inflation warning, then dropped to a six-month low after FSSAI notices (21-22 Oct 2026).

exposures.mechanism: Milk and milk products ~25% of costs (approximate, model knowledge); costs ~76% of sales. +8% milk => costs +2.0% => 1.5% of sales => EBITDA -6.3% at 24% margin; ~50% price pass-through => -3.2; persistence 0.5; EV/MCap 1.0 => -1.6.

evidence.note: ET: Nestle India says rising inflation, particularly food inflation, is a reality

exposures.mechanism: Green coffee and cocoa ~13% of costs. +15% => costs +1.95% => 1.5% of sales => EBITDA -6.2%; 50% pricing recovery => -3.1; persistence 0.5 => -1.5. Cocoa/coffee are volatile imports priced in USD.

evidence.note: gross margin sensitivity from OPM 24% vs 26% in Mar-26 quarter

exposures.mechanism: Wheat flour for Maggi ~8% of costs. +10% => costs +0.8% => 0.6% of sales => EBITDA -2.5%; 50% pass-through; persistence 0.5 => -0.6. Empirical +0.62 (t=1.1) has the opposite sign but is insignificant (food-inflation demand co-movement).
Palm/vegetable oils ~7% of costs (snacks, noodles). +10% => EBITDA -2.2%; 50% passthrough, persistence 0.5 => -0.55. India cut import duty 24 Sep 2026.
Sugar ~4% of costs. +10% => EBITDA -1.3%; 50% pass-through; persistence 0.5 => -0.3. Sugar is +27.8% since June and +18.6% in three months. Empirical +0.85 (t=1.6) opposite sign, treated as noise.
Packaging ~12% of costs. +10% => costs +1.2% => EBITDA -3.8%; 50% passthrough, persistence 0.5 => -0.9.

~15% of costs imported/USD-linked (coffee, cocoa, packaging, some finished goods) => +3% INR weakness => EBITDA -1.4% before pass-through; persistence 0.5 => -0.4. Empirical +1.26 (t=1.2) opposite sign, insignificant.

Urban ~65-70% of sales; strong quick-commerce channel (NDTV Profit preview 2026-10-14). +5pp urban => sales +3.3% x 40% incremental margin/24% => EBITDA +5.5%, persistence 0.5 => +2.7; trimmed to +2.2.

evidence.note: sales growth +20% y/y in Sep-26 quarter; Q1 +25%

exposures.mechanism: Rural ~20-25% of sales: +5pp => sales +1.2%, EBITDA +2% x 0.5 persistence => +0.9.

FSSAI notices on baby-food claims (Lactogen) and an unsafe sample reported 3 Oct raise recall/ban/label risk. Infant nutrition ~7-8% of sales, higher margin. +1 step => infant-nutrition sales -10% and brand cost => EBITDA -3.5% plus multiple penalty; persistence 0.5; probability-weighted => -2.

evidence.note: Moneycontrol/Livemint: FSSAI notices to Nestle India, Zydus Wellness; shares at six-month low
Investing.com: Nestle India product sample declared unsafe

exposures.mechanism: P/E 60.9, ROE 74%, negligible funding cost: multiple is the only channel. +25bp repo => ~-1.3 on valuation duration.
Quick-commerce is Nestle's fastest channel (Maggi, KitKat, coffee); +1 acceleration => +1% sales mix gain at favourable gross margin => EBITDA +1.5%... persistence 1.0 x 0.5 execution => +1.0.

evidence.note: NDTV Profit: Q-Comm to lead growth
